title: The Payment Screenshot
intro: You are selling 500 ZLUSD on a peer-to-peer marketplace. A buyer says they have paid.
Now they send a screenshot and ask you to release the coins fast.
Pick your replies, and sniff each message.

screen.context: Your bank app has not shown any new money yet.

replies.text: My bank shows nothing yet. Can I check?
I will wait until my own bank app shows the money
A screenshot is not money. Reporting

shot.label: A screenshot as proof
shot.lens: Screenshots are easy to fake or edit.
shot.why: The only proof is money showing in your own bank app.

rush.label: "Release now"
rush.lens: Pressure to hand over coins before you check.
rush.why: Once coins are released, they cannot be taken back.

status.label: "Payment sent", not received
status.lens: Sent is not the same as arrived.
status.why: A pending or sent screen can be reversed or never happen.

bank.label: "Banks are slow"
bank.lens: A reason to skip the check.
bank.why: A real buyer will wait while you check.

actions.label: Wait until the money shows in my own bank app
Block the buyer and report them

verify.line: You waited. No money ever arrived, and the buyer vanished. Your coins stayed yours. Case cracked.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The marketplace removed the buyer.

go_ahead.line: No payment ever arrived. The coins were gone for good.

what_if.go_ahead: A look at your own bank app would have shown nothing. A screenshot is not money.
what_if.block_report: Blocking was safe. Waiting for the money in your own bank app also works.

golden_rule: Release coins only when the money is in your own account. A screenshot is not a payment.

quick_check.q: A buyer sends a payment screenshot and asks you to release your coins now. Your bank app shows nothing. What do you do?

options.text: Wait until the money shows in your own bank app
Ask them to send another screenshot

quick_check.explain: Only the money in your own account counts. Screenshots can be faked in seconds.

hints.nudge: What does your own bank app say?

rows.v: Only after the money arrives in your account
